questions.text: How would you reduce hallucinations in an LLM-powered feature that answers questions from a knowledge base?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: RAG with grounded citations, retrieval quality, prompt constraints, output validation.

questions.text: Walk me through how you'd design a RAG pipeline end to end.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Chunking strategy, embedding model choice, vector store, retrieval + reranking, prompt assembly.

questions.text: How do you evaluate the quality of an LLM-generated output when there's no single correct answer?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: LLM-as-judge, rubric-based human eval, golden test sets, regression testing on prompts.

questions.text: How would you control cost and latency in an application that makes many LLM calls per request?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Caching, prompt/response size limits, model tiering, batching, streaming.

questions.text: Describe how you'd design tool use / function calling for an agent so it fails safely.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Schema validation, sandboxing, timeouts, retries, human-in-the-loop for risky actions.

questions.text: Tell me about a time an LLM feature you built produced an unexpected or wrong output in front of users. What did you do?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Incident handling, guardrails added afterward, communication with stakeholders.

questions.text: Describe a time you had to explain the limitations of an AI feature to a non-technical stakeholder.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Managing expectations, translating uncertainty into concrete guardrails.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you iterated on a prompt or pipeline many times before it was reliable enough to ship.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Systematic iteration, eval-driven development, patience with ambiguity.

questions.text: Describe a situation where you had to choose between a faster, cheaper model and a more capable, expensive one.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Tradeoff framing tied to product requirements and user impact.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you collaborated with product or design on an AI feature's UX around uncertainty.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Cross-functional communication, designing for AI limitations transparently.
